title: rAthena battleground.conf
description: Generated by Tools.RathenaImporter from rAthena .conf. Each property's description is the inline comment from the source file.

bg_short_attack_damage_rate.description:
--------------------------------------------------------------
rAthena Battle Configuration File
Originally Translated by Peter Kieser <pfak@telus.net>
Made in to plainer English by Ancyker
--------------------------------------------------------------
Note 1: Value is a config switch (on/off, yes/no or 1/0)
Note 2: Value is in percents (100 means 100%)
Note 3: Value is a bit field. If no description is given,
assume unit types (1: Pc, 2: Mob, 4: Pet, 8: Homun, 16: Mercenary, 128: NPC, 512: Elemental)
--------------------------------------------------------------
Melee damage adjustments (non skills) for Battleground maps (Note 2)

bg_long_attack_damage_rate.description: Ranged damage adjustments (non skills) for Battleground maps (Note 2)

bg_weapon_attack_damage_rate.description: Weapon skills damage adjustments for Battleground maps (Note 2)

bg_magic_attack_damage_rate.description: Magic skills damage adjustments for Battleground maps (Note 2)

bg_misc_attack_damage_rate.description: Misc skills damage adjustments for Battleground maps (Note 2)

bg_flee_penalty.description:
Flee penalty on BG grounds.
NOTE: It's %, not absolute, so 20 is -20% of your total flee

bg_update_interval.description: Interval before updating the bg-member map mini-dots (milliseconds)

bgqueue_nowarp_mapflag.description:
Before a player is warped into a Battleground from the Battleground Queue,
check to see if the player's current map has MF_NOWARP.
